name: Pixel
description: Android's Material 3 Expressive, so far for the shade (notifications, controls, banners)
author: Launcher
_about: Pixel's look as a theme on iOS 27's (docs/SHADE_PIXEL_EVALUATION.md, step 1): written by tools/design/build_pixel_theme.py from AOSP's numbers and captures of the Android 17 emulator's shade. Only what differs from iOS 27 is written here; its colours are the phone's palette by role, as a Pixel's.
